title: Type Sizes, Limits and sizeof
learningObjectives: Describe type sizes, limits and sizeof.
Recognize its syntax and important rules.
Explain the sample programs and predict their results.
Use this concept in a small program.
Identify common mistakes and choose a safer approach.

understand.concept: sizeof returns the size in bytes of an object or type. C++ guarantees relationships and minimum sizes, not one universal byte count for every type. Use limits from the standard library when you need numeric ranges.
understand.whyItMatters: Correct data declarations and type choices make C++ programs easier to understand, safer and more portable.
understand.explain: Avoid assumptions about type sizes across platforms. sizeof(char) is always 1, but one byte is not necessarily eight bits on every implementation. Numeric limits provides reliable implementation-specific range information.
